hero.title: Precision immune-specificity mapping for human disease.
hero.description: We map T-cell antigen specificity in patient samples using genetic screens, single-cell profiling, and synthetic biology. Our goal is to uncover mechanisms in autoimmunity, cancer, and infection, then translate them into next-generation targeted therapies.

culture_preview: We combine high standards with supportive mentorship, transparent communication, and celebrations of team milestones.
